data.body: CLOSED via change https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1044 (MERGED as 6526cfeae, patchset 2, LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Class: regression — the tests were broken by our own recently-landed 228b DET-floor short-circuit (c781127a2). PS1 (the DET-floor fixture fix): the fixture plan now PASSES the deterministic floor (proper '## Acceptance Criteria' checklist) and the counting fake manufactures the BLOCK from the LLM tier (an F1 finding, blocking posture at threshold 0.60, verified full-yes at high severity), restoring the 'finder re-ran' oracles for --force and code-drift while keeping verdict_reuse's zero-call BLOCK-reuse semantics. PS2 (self-containment) — CREDIT: this patchset exists because of the operator's observation that CI runs pytest -n 4 --dist worksteal, where dynamic worker placement can reshuffle which tests share a worker/process and re-expose shared-state or order dependence the default placement happened to hide. Shared state found and removed: (1) byte-identical fixture material across tests — Pass-1 chunk checkpoints are keyed by material fingerprint, so identical material was one fingerprint-derivation change away from cross-test cached-chunk reads (a cached chunk makes zero finder calls, silently breaking the call-count oracles); every test's ticket (and the material-change edit) now carries a unique material nonce. (2) Ambient REBAR_USAGE_LOG — if set in the environment, all tests append to ONE shared telemetry file; now cleared per-test. (3) Ambient REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET — changes criteria shedding and thus the observable call pattern; now cleared per-test. Audit found no order dependence otherwise: each test builds its own tmp repo/store (REBAR_ROOT + chdir per-test), registry caches are repo-keyed, render/exit-code tests are pure. Proven: 5x file runs + the reuse/det_short_circuit/plan_review_gate neighborhood under -n 4 --dist worksteal, and every test passing alone; make lint + make typecheck clean.
